proposal.before: Hongli’s bearing and form outwardly bright, Yeye’s spirit mirror inwardly fused, Zhongzu warm and moist, elegant bearing, Youdao clear and empty, few desires—all monopolized fame south of the Yangzi, were esteemed in their time—how could they be only the empress clan’s flower; they were also the girdled sash’s fine repute.
proposal.after: Hongli’s bearing and form outwardly bright, Jiye’s spirit mirror inwardly fused, Zhongzu warm and moist, elegant bearing, Youdao clear and empty, few desires—all monopolized fame south of the Yangzi, were esteemed in their time—how could they be only the empress clan’s flower; they were also the girdled sash’s fine repute.
proposal.sourceBasedReason: 季野 romanizes as Jiye, not Yeye. This is the same mis-romanization corrected in s0021, and the paired idiomatic text correctly says Chu Pou.
proposal.pairedFieldChecked: Du Yi’s looks were open and bright; Chu Pou read men with inward clarity; Wang Meng moved with gentle grace; He Zhun lived spare and detached—all were luminaries south of the Yangzi and pillars of their age, ornaments not only to the imperial in-laws but to the whole gentry.

units.zh: 若褚季野之畏避朝權，王叔仁之固求出鎮，用能全身遠害，有可稱焉。
units.en: Chu Pou shrank from wielding power at court, and Wang Shu begged to be sent to the frontier; both kept their skins and their honor, and deserve mention.
units.literal: As for Chu Yeye’s fearing and avoiding court power, and Wang Shuren’s firmly seeking to go out and hold a command, by this they were able to preserve the body and keep far from harm—there is something to praise in that.

units.en: His grandfather was Chu Pou; his father Chu Xin.
units.literal: His grandfather was Pou; his father Xin.

units.zh: 弘理儀形外朗，季野神鑒內融，仲祖溫潤風流，幼道清虛寡欲，皆擅名江表，見重當時，豈惟后族之英華，抑亦搢紳之令望者也。
